note: Colombia: nationals of the countries listed enter without a visa for 90 days, extendable to 180 in a calendar year (Israel 90 in 180; Canadians pay an entry fee on arrival, not modelled). Everyone else needs a visa, applied for online through the Ministry of Foreign Affairs. Read from Wikipedia's copy of Migración Colombia's list.

sources.said: Citizens of the following countries and territories may enter Colombia without a visa for stays up to the duration listed below.
